KANCITY
DETAILED SCREENPLAY-STYLE RETELLING
ORIGINAL RETELLING — HAND-WRITTEN VOICE REFERENCE
(Corrected version of system draft, for training comparison)

NOTE: This is an original, scene-oriented retelling based on true events. It does not reproduce any copyrighted material.

========================================
ACT I — A LIFE ALMOST REBUILT
========================================

FADE IN:

EXT. UNIVERSITY CAMPUS — DAY

KAN arrives.

He is a freshman.

All his friends got in before him. This is his turn, finally.

He feels proud. He feels like he belongs.

INT. HOSTEL ROOM — DAY

Kan settles in.

The excitement does not last long.

His wallet is gone.

He does not notice at first. He has money in it. He has his friend's number in it.

His phone rings.

His friend tells him something strange. A group of men called. They say they have his wallet.

They leave a number.

INT. CAMPUS — AFTER CLASSES

Kan calls the number.

A voice answers.

The voice tells him to come outside the school gates.

Kan hesitates.

He has not left the hostel grounds since he arrived. He does not know the streets. He does not know these people.

But the wallet has money in it.

He goes.

EXT. MEETING POINT — 5 P.M.

Kan finds them.

More than seven men. Seated. Drinking.

They wave him over.

He sits.

They tell him to drink.

He says no.

The mood changes.

He understands, fast, that no is not really an option here.

He drinks.

After a while, he says he has to go. He has to get back to the hostel.

He does not know it yet. This is the beginning.

CUT TO BLACK.

========================================
ACT II — THE HUNT BEGINS
========================================

EXT. MEETING POINT — CONTINUOUS

The group Kan has just met is not ordinary.

They are Viking Confraternity.

The deadliest cult in the state. One of the deadliest in the country.

One of the men at the table outranks the rest.

They call him EMK.

He is the executioner.

Kan does not know this yet.

Other men pass by. Rough men. Men with reputations.

They greet the table.

When they greet EMK, they use both hands.

Kan notices. He does not fully understand what it means. But he understands that it means something.

As Kan grows restless, EMK's manner shifts.

EMK asks about his studies.

He sounds almost fatherly.

Before Kan leaves, EMK gives him a number.

Call me, he says, if you ever run into trouble.

EXT. CAMPUS — LATER

Kan walks back to his hostel.

He feels relieved. He feels, strangely, a little good about it.

He does not know what he has just agreed to.

He does not know it will threaten everything he came here to build.

FADE OUT.

========================================
STRUCTURAL LESSON
========================================

Ordinary excitement of a new beginning
        ↓
A small, ordinary loss (the wallet)
        ↓
An unfamiliar world entered out of necessity
        ↓
Pressure disguised as hospitality
        ↓
Forced compliance under threat
        ↓
Revelation of who he has actually met
        ↓
A gesture of false kindness that binds him further
        ↓
Relief that masks the real danger
        ↓
The ordinary world quietly compromised
